set.body:
Create the durable reference matrix for the remaining port.

Contracts: map ScalaFIM behavior to volregger references in R/control.R, R/profiles.R, R/fd_dvars.R, R/qc.R, R/apply_motion.R, R/estimate_motion.R, src/api_apply.cpp, src/api_estimate.cpp, src/api_spline.cpp, and the synthetic testthat suites.

Deliverables: small generated fixture files under modules/motion/shared/src/test/resources/motion/ plus a generator or reproducible script that records the volregger commit/local version.

Acceptance: fixtures cover pose matrices, inverse/compose, FD, DVARS, robust DVARS, displacement summaries, apply interpolation/padding, estimator synthetic runs, spline/packet timing, IC/whitening scenarios, and CLI/report golden metadata; shared fixture tests pass on motionJVM/test and motionJS/test where runtime permits.
set.title: Motion parity matrix and volregger fixture generator
